definition.title: Capecitabine: treatment and checks
definition.status: Source reconciled; independent clinical, pharmacy and patient/PPI review pending
definition.summary: capecitabine twice daily on Days 1–14, then no capecitabine on Days 15–21. Follow your individual prescription.

lanes.label: Blood count / kidneys / liver
cells: Baseline bloods; DPD before fluoropyrimidine
Repeat before each cycle
Earlier tests if unwell, dehydrated or toxicity develops
Results and recovery guide any delay or dose change
Follow unresolved abnormalities

lanes.label: Symptoms and function
cells: Document existing symptoms and usual activity
Review worst symptoms since the last treatment
Use urgent contacts; do not wait for the next visit
Balance benefit, side effects and priorities
Agree recovery care and ongoing support

Review adherence, mouth, bowel and skin symptoms
Days 1–14 tablets; Days 15–21 planned break unless team changes it
Do not restart held tablets or replace missed doses without advice
Return unused tablets as instructed; follow persistent symptoms

Review clinical benefit and symptoms

Consultant-directed scans and response assessment

milestones.title: 21-day tablet cycle
milestones.why: Capecitabine is chemotherapy taken as tablets. NCCP 00216 covers several colorectal and breast cancer settings, including treatment after surgery and treatment of advanced disease. Ask which aim and duration apply to you.
milestones.clinical: capecitabine twice daily on Days 1–14, then no capecitabine on Days 15–21. Follow your individual prescription.
milestones.action: Confirm the current phase, prescription, tests and support medicines.

definition.title: Weekly cetuximab + FOLFOX-4: treatment and checks
definition.status: Source reconciled; independent clinical, pharmacy and patient/PPI review pending
definition.summary: Cetuximab on Day 1 and Day 8. FOLFOX4 starts on Day 1: oxaliplatin, folinic acid and fluorouracil bolus, followed by a 22-hour fluorouracil infusion. Day 2 brings another fluorouracil bolus and a second 22-hour infusion; finish around Day 3. Your team confirms the full Day 2 prescription. Repeat every 14 days while beneficial and tolerable.

lanes.label: Blood counts, kidney and liver
cells: Baseline blood count, kidney and liver profile
Review results before treatment
Blood count, kidney and liver tests before each cycle
Repeat sooner if symptoms or results need it
Follow any unresolved abnormal result
lanes.note: The columns show order, not equal periods. There is no fixed number of cycles for these plans. Agree who books each check, when results are reviewed and whom to contact if a check is missed.

lanes.label: Magnesium, calcium and potassium
cells: Check mineral levels before starting
Repeat periodically during treatment
Keep blood-test and replacement appointments
More checks may be needed if levels fall or diarrhoea develops
Monthly checks for two months after the last antibody dose
lanes.note: The columns show order, not equal periods. There is no fixed number of cycles for these plans. Agree who books each check, when results are reviewed and whom to contact if a check is missed.

lanes.label: Skin, nails, eyes and breathing
cells: Discuss existing skin, eye or lung problems
Start the prescribed skin-care plan; report reactions early
Review skin, nails, diarrhoea and new symptoms
Eye pain, worsening breathing or severe rash needs prompt assessment
Continue care until symptoms and mineral levels settle

lanes.label: Fluorouracil safety and line
cells: Confirm the DPD test and safe line/pump arrangements
Check mouth, bowel and pump symptoms early
Review line, pump and previous-cycle toxicity
Report chest pain or unexpectedly severe early side effects immediately
Confirm disconnection and ongoing line care
lanes.note: The columns show order, not equal periods. There is no fixed number of cycles for these plans. Agree who books each check, when results are reviewed and whom to contact if a check is missed.

lanes.label: Heart history and new symptoms
cells: Review heart history; ECG if cardiac function is compromised
Report chest pain or new breathlessness immediately
Review new symptoms before further treatment
Further heart tests when clinically indicated
Follow any heart problem; no routine serial echo timetable
lanes.note: The columns show order, not equal periods. There is no fixed number of cycles for these plans. Agree who books each check, when results are reviewed and whom to contact if a check is missed.

lanes.label: Nerve symptoms
cells: Record any numbness or tingling before treatment
Cold sensitivity can occur early
Formal neuropathy assessment every two cycles
Report persistent symptoms or difficulty with daily tasks before the next dose
Follow symptoms after oxaliplatin stops
lanes.note: The columns show order, not equal periods. There is no fixed number of cycles for these plans. Agree who books each check, when results are reviewed and whom to contact if a check is missed.

lanes.label: Cancer response and treatment choices
cells: Record baseline disease and agree review plan
Bring forward review if symptoms worsen
Scans and other tests follow your consultant’s treatment plan
Discuss benefit, side effects and whether the goal has changed
Agree continuation, a break, another treatment or supportive care
lanes.note: The columns show order, not equal periods. There is no fixed number of cycles for these plans. Agree who books each check, when results are reviewed and whom to contact if a check is missed.

milestones.title: A 14-day reference cycle
milestones.why: The aim is to control advanced bowel cancer and symptoms. The team reviews how well treatment is working and whether side effects remain acceptable; there is no single fixed number of cycles for everyone.
